map.根据碳水化合物摄入量和血糖计算餐时胰岛素剂量: Calculate the mealtime insulin dose from carbohydrate intake and blood glucose
map.📖 查看「餐时胰岛素剂量计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Mealtime Insulin Dose Calculator User Guide"
map.碳水剂量 = 碳水摄入(g) ÷ 碳水系数(g/U): Carb dose = carb intake (g) ÷ carb ratio (g/U)
map.= (当前血糖 - 目标血糖) ÷ 胰岛素敏感系数: = (current glucose − target glucose) ÷ insulin sensitivity factor
map.= 碳水剂量 + 校正剂量 - 体内活性胰岛素: = carb dose + correction dose − active insulin in body
map.注：碳水系数因人而异，需在医生或营养师指导下确定: Note: the carb ratio varies between individuals and must be determined under a doctor's or dietitian's guidance
map.• 腹部（吸收最快最稳定）：脐周5cm以外: • Abdomen (fastest and most stable absorption): more than 5 cm from the navel
map.• 大腿外侧：吸收较慢，适合中长效: • Outer thigh: slower absorption, suitable for intermediate- and long-acting insulin
map.• 上臂外侧：吸收速度中等: • Outer upper arm: moderate absorption rate
map.• 每次注射点间距至少2cm: • Keep injection points at least 2 cm apart each time
map.• 同区域内按规律轮换: • Rotate systematically within the same area
map.• 避免在同一部位反复注射: • Avoid repeated injections at the same spot
map.• 长效胰岛素：每日固定时间: • Long-acting insulin: at a fixed time daily
map.• 糖尿病患者：血糖 ≤ 3.9 mmol/L (70 mg/dL): • People with diabetes: blood glucose ≤ 3.9 mmol/L (70 mg/dL)
map.• 非糖尿病患者：血糖 ≤ 2.8 mmol/L (50 mg/dL): • People without diabetes: blood glucose ≤ 2.8 mmol/L (50 mg/dL)
map.• 交感神经兴奋：心慌、出汗、手抖、饥饿感: • Sympathetic activation: palpitations, sweating, hand tremor, hunger
map.• 中枢神经症状：头晕、视物模糊、意识障碍、抽搐: • Central nervous symptoms: dizziness, blurred vision, impaired consciousness, convulsions
map.• 注意：长期糖尿病或使用β受体阻滞剂者症状可能不典型: • Note: symptoms may be atypical in long-standing diabetes or in those taking beta-blockers
map.1. 立即补充15g快速碳水（半杯果汁、3块方糖、1勺蜂蜜）: 1. Immediately take 15 g of fast carbs (half a glass of juice, 3 sugar cubes, 1 spoon of honey)
map.2. 等待15分钟后复测血糖: 2. Wait 15 minutes and re-check blood glucose
map.3. 如仍低，再补15g，重复直到血糖正常: 3. If still low, take another 15 g and repeat until glucose is normal
map.4. 血糖恢复后，如距下次正餐＞1小时，补充慢碳（面包、饼干）: 4. After glucose recovers, if the next meal is more than 1 hour away, take slow carbs (bread, crackers)
map.• 昏迷者切勿喂食，防止窒息: • Never feed someone who is unconscious, to prevent choking
map.本计算器仅供教育参考，不能替代医生建议。胰岛素剂量必须由专业医师根据个体情况制定: This calculator is for educational reference only and cannot replace a doctor's advice. Insulin doses must be set by a professional physician according to individual circumstances; do not adjust your dose on your own. If in doubt, consult an endocrinologist or diabetes education nurse.
map.1 型或胰岛素治疗的 2 型糖友，按当前血糖、目标血糖、碳水与活性胰岛素计算餐时: For people with type 1 diabetes or insulin-treated type 2 diabetes, calculate the mealtime dose from current glucose, target glucose, carbs and active insulin.
map.用胰岛素‑碳水比(ICR)与校正因子(ISF)把「吃多少、血多高」转为精确单位。: Use the insulin-to-carb ratio (ICR) and correction factor (ISF) to turn "how much you eat and how high your glucose is" into a precise number of units.
map.避免叠加活性胰岛素导致迟发低血糖，需扣除体内残留。: To avoid stacking active insulin and causing delayed hypoglycemia, subtract the remaining active insulin.
map.输入：当前血糖 8.5、目标 5.5 mmol/L、ICR=10（每 10g 碳: Input: current glucose 8.5, target 5.5 mmol/L, ICR=10 (1 U per 10 g carbs), ISF=2.5 (1 U lowers glucose by 2.5), this meal's carbs 60 g, active insulin 0. Carb dose = 60 ÷ 10 = 6.0 U; correction dose = (8.5−5.5) ÷ 2.5 = 1.2 U; total mealtime = 6.0 + 1.2 − 0 = 7.2 U. Conclusion: about 7.2 U of mealtime insulin should be injected for this meal; if 2 U was given 2 hours ago and is still active, reduce it to 5.2 U to prevent stacking hypoglycemia.
map.ICR 和 ISF 怎么定？: How are ICR and ISF determined?
map.ICR（胰岛素‑碳水比）常用 500/1800 法则估算（500÷每日胰岛素总量: The ICR (insulin-to-carb ratio) is commonly estimated with the 500/1800 rule (500 ÷ total daily insulin ≈ grams per unit), and ISF ≈ 100 ÷ total daily dose × 18 (mmol basis). Individual variation is large, so an endocrinologist must adjust them individually based on blood glucose logs; this tool simply calculates with the given factors.
map.为什么必须减掉「活性胰岛素」？: Why must active insulin be subtracted?
map.速效胰岛素作用可持续 3–4 小时，若上一次剂量仍活性就直接追加，会叠加致严重低: Rapid-acting insulin can act for 3-4 hours, so if the previous dose is still active and you add another dose directly, stacking can cause severe hypoglycemia. This tool deducts with "active insulin (IOB)", the same principle as an insulin pump's calculation; when calculating at home you should also estimate the remaining insulin before injecting more.
